{{Top|leg}}
'''D'al''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Commenting on the Datalog's entry for the [[Kloo horn/Legends|kloo horn]], D'al mentioned that the kloo horn was perfect for [[Musician/Legends|musicians]] playing rowdy venues, because it could be used as an effective [[Truncheon/Legends|truncheon]] in an emergency.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
